heading: Thursday
text: Mostly sunny, except increasing afternoon clouds in the St. Lawrence Valley. Highs in the mid to upper 60s, some lower 60s northeast. South to southwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph from the Champlain Valley westward.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Partly cloudy south. Becoming mostly cloudy north, with a chance of showers near the international border, slight chance down to around Route 2. Lows in the mid to upper 40s. South winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph west of the Greens.
